correctness.rationale: For degree one, the coupling sums agree identically; K3 normalized strength is kappa/2. The potential V=||x||²/2+sum(x_i^4)/4-kappa x^T Lx/2 is proper, gradient flow with bounded trajectories. The exact stationary depressed cubic x_i^3-(3kappa-1)x_i+kappa S=0 exhausts all equal, three-distinct, and exactly-two-equal cases; the strictly increasing ratio cubic has one root -2<s<-2^(1/3), giving six paired states plus six distinct and zero. At zero Hessian index two; the six all-distinct Hessians have one negative eigenvalue; factorized block determinants prove six sinks. Bounded gradient trajectories have connected omega limit in finite critical set, hence converge to a single equilibrium; stable manifolds of hyperbolic nonsinks have measure zero. At kappa=1/3 quartic positivity establishes global but not exponential decay. Independent exact/numeric check kappa=.5 reconstructed 13 roots and indices {0:6,1:6,2:1}.
